### Orthofix to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results


July 15, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/785927921/files/doc_news/Orthofix-to-Report-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-2026.pdf)


***Company to Host Conference Call on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, at 8:30 am Eastern Time***


LEWISVILLE, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Orthofix Medical Inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Forthofix.com%2F&esheet=54559306&newsitemid=20260715436061&lan=en-US&anchor=Orthofix+Medical+Inc&index=1&md5=dd4e2e9a1a33e699ca7d1b81d7a00f6b) . (NASDAQ:OFIX), a leading global medical technology company, today announced that it will release its second quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, before market open. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to review results at 8:30 am Eastern Time the same day.


Interested parties may access the conference call by dialing (888) 596-4144 in the U.S., and (646) 968-2525 in all other locations, and referencing the conference ID 8700861. A webcast of the conference call and a copy of the release may be accessed at[ir.Orthofix.com.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.orthofix.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54559306&newsitemid=20260715436061&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.Orthofix.com.&index=2&md5=a16ce1fffda6cd60f17d7773c27b84a3)


**Internet Posting of Information**


Orthofix regularly shares important updates in the “Investors” section of its website at[www.orthofix.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Forthofix.com%2F&esheet=54559306&newsitemid=20260715436061&lan=en-US&anchor=www.orthofix.com&index=3&md5=a202a1058e46ae9647350c52b8538710) . The Company encourages investors and potential investors to consult the Orthofix website regularly for important information about Orthofix.


**About Orthofix**


Orthofix is a global medical technology company dedicated to advancing healing and restoring mobility for patients with complex musculoskeletal conditions. Headquartered in Lewisville, Texas, the Company delivers technology-enabled solutions that support improved clinical outcomes and more efficient care across the continuum. Orthofix offers a focused and differentiated portfolio spanning spinal implants, therapeutic solutions, limb reconstruction systems, biologics and enabling technologies, including the 7D FLASH™ Navigation System. Learn more at[Orthofix.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Forthofix.com%2F&esheet=54559306&newsitemid=20260715436061&lan=en-US&anchor=Orthofix.com&index=4&md5=56d920af2a621e728a08c8429fc7ba51) and follow Orthofix on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Forthofix%2Fposts%2F&esheet=54559306&newsitemid=20260715436061&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=5&md5=c8c271001d5771274c74507eaf2b66bf) .
